policy: runtime/2014_engine_decisions.md E1; user choice 'Honours + role'; runtime/defect_register.md item 1

tier_rule.window: the two most recent completed pre-divergence seasons before the season being predicted (2012 target: 2010-2011 honours; 2014 branch: 2011-2012 honours)
tier_rule.Elite: any AP All-Pro 1st team in the window
tier_rule.Plus: AP All-Pro 2nd team or an original Pro Bowl selection in the window
tier_rule.Average: everyone else (low-confidence fallback: insufficient knowledge, not verified average)
tier_rule.alternates_replacements: no effect: a replacement is chosen after withdrawals from a truncated pool, its announcement date is not pinned, and 2012-season replacements may post-date the divergence
tier_rule.specialists: K/P/KR/PR/LS/ST honours feed special teams only, never the offense/defense composites

preregistered.player_value: max over admissible honours of (tier_value - 2) * evidence_weight
preregistered.unit_composite: sum over the unit's starters of position_weight * player_value
preregistered.role_source_primary: the club's Week 1 regular-season depth chart, depth_team 1, formation Offense/Defense (role only, not ability)
preregistered.role_source_sensitivity: all players on the club's Week 1 weekly roster (status ACT) grouped by position; at most one QB (highest value)
preregistered.targets: per-drive touchdown share (fixed_drive_result == 'Touchdown') and points per drive, offense and defense, 2012 regular season, all drives with a possession team
preregistered.fit: one slope per side by drive-weighted least squares on the 32 clubs (with intercept); shrinkage prior N(0, 0.025^2) per composite unit (the installed kernel's per-tier edge); leave-one-club-out prediction; joint drive-level check with home indicator and game-cluster bootstrap (500 draws, seed 20140401)
preregistered.edge_target: implied true SD of per-drive offense-minus-defense TD-share difference about 0.048 (offense:defense variance about 4:1), derived from 2012 nflverse drives; reported, never used to inflate the fitted scale
preregistered.clamp: installed kernel: edge = clip((off_anchor - def_anchor) * 0.025 + 0.008 home, -0.06, 0.06)
